results.name: Jumping Jack
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out to the sides while simultaneously raising your arms overhead, forming an "X" shape with your body.
Quickly jump back to the starting position with your feet together and your arms at your sides.
Repeat the movement for the desired duration or number of repetitions, maintaining a steady rhythm.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your knees throughout the exercise to absorb impact and reduce strain on your joints.
Keep your movements light and quick to enhance cardiovascular benefits.
Engage your shoulders and back muscles when raising your arms to ensure full range of motion.
Keep your gaze forward and your head in a neutral position to maintain alignment.
results.description: Jumping Jack is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean and Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell placed on the floor between your feet. Bend your knees and hinge at your hips to grab the kettlebell with your right hand.

Explosively extend your hips and knees to lift the kettlebell off the floor and swing it up to shoulder height. As the kettlebell rises, rotate your wrist to catch it in a rack position with your elbow bent and close to your body.
Press the kettlebell overhead by extending your right arm fully, keeping your wrist straight and aligned with your shoulder.
Lower the kettlebell back to the rack position with control, then return it to the starting position on the floor. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left hand.
tips: Use your hips and legs to generate power for the clean.
Use an appropriate weight to maintain proper form and control.
Keep your wrist straight and aligned with your forearm during the press.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Arm Clean and Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge Pullover
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor, holding a kettlebell with both hands extended straight on the floor. Extend your right leg upwards bent at 90 degrees.

Press through your left heel to lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your shoulders to your left knee. Simultaneously, extend the kettlebell overhead with both arms, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your hips back to the floor while bringing the kettlebell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to your left leg extended and perform the same motion.
tips: Lower the kettlebell and your hips in a controlled manner to prevent any sudden movements or loss of balance.
Focus on squeezing your glutes at the top of the bridge for maximum activation.
Inhale as you lower your hips and the kettlebell, and exhale as you lift them.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Leg Glute Bridge Pullover is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Shoulders, Triceps.

results.name: Kettlebell Sled Drag
instructions: Place a kettlebell on the sled and attach a rope or strap to it.
Face the sled and walk backward, or face away and walk forward, holding the strap.
Drag the sled with steady, powerful steps.
Continue for the set distance with your core braced.
tips: Keep your chest up.
Walking backward targets the quadriceps more.
results.description: Kettlebell Sled Drag is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a sled machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Snatch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge at your hips and grab the handle with one hand.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, then drive your hips forward and pull it straight up close to your body.
Punch your hand through as the bell flips onto your forearm, locking out overhead; lower it back into the next swing.
tips: Keep the bell close to avoid it slamming your forearm.
Power comes from your hips, not your arm.
results.description: Kettlebell Snatch is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Lower Back, Traps, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Strict Press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand, close to the front of your shoulder. The kettlebell should rest against the back of your wrist, with your palm facing inward and your elbow close to your body facing down.
Press the kettlebell directly overhead by extending your arm upward, keeping your wrist straight.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position with control, returning it to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left hand and perform the exercise on the other side.
tips: Maintain a neutral wrist position to avoid strain.
Avoid using momentum; focus on a slow, controlled press.
Exhale as you press the kettlebell up and inhale as you lower it.
results.description: Kettlebell Strict Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Upper Chest.

results.name: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift High Pull
instructions: Place a kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart and your toes pointed slightly outward.
Hinge at your hips and bend your knees to lower your body, reaching down to grasp the kettlebell handle with both hands, keeping your back straight and chest up.

Push through your heels to lift the kettlebell off the floor, extending your hips and knees simultaneously. As you reach the standing position, explosively pull the kettlebell upward towards your chin by bending your elbows and keeping them pointed outward.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a weight that allows you to maintain proper form throughout the exercise.
Push through your heels to maximize power and stability.
Ensure your knees track over your toes to prevent knee strain.
results.description: Kettlebell Sumo Deadlift High Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.

results.name: Kettlebell Swing (45 Degree View)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward. Place a kettlebell vertically on the floor between your feet. Bend at your hips and knees to reach forward and grab the kettlebell with both hands, interlocking your fingers.
Hinge at your hips to swing the kettlebell back between your legs, allowing a slight bend in your knees.

Drive through your hips, extending them forcefully to swing the kettlebell forward and up to shoulder height. Allow the momentum to carry the kettlebell upwards, keeping your arms straight but not locked.
As the kettlebell begins to descend, hinge at your hips again to let it swing back between your legs, preparing for the next repetition. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use the power from your hips, not your arms, to generate the swing.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Exhale as you swing the kettlebell up, inhale as it swings back down.
results.description: Kettlebell Swing (45 Degree View) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Kettlebell Swing
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward. Place a kettlebell on the floor between your feet. Bend at your hips and knees to reach forward and grab the kettlebell with both hands, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Hinge at your hips to swing the kettlebell back between your legs, allowing a slight bend in your knees.

Drive through your hips, extending them forcefully to swing the kettlebell forward and up to shoulder height. Allow the momentum to carry the kettlebell upwards, keeping your arms straight but not locked.
As the kettlebell begins to descend, hinge at your hips again to let it swing back between your legs, preparing for the next repetition. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use the power from your hips, not your arms, to generate the swing.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Exhale as you swing the kettlebell up, inhale as it swings back down.
results.description: Kettlebell Swing is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Kettlebell Thruster
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing inward. Keep your elbows close to your.
Lower into a squat by bending your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously pressing the kettlebells overhead. Fully extend your arms at the top of the movement.
Lower the kettlebells back to shoulder level as you prepare for the next repetition. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the kettlebells overhead, inhale as you lower into the squat.
Choose an appropriate weight to maintain control throughout the exercise.
Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
results.description: Kettlebell Thruster is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.
